name: M3_PMS100MI_CrtMO
description: Create a new manufacturing order header for a specific product in a facility. The operation generates a manufacturing order number and can also return a batch job number for background processing. It records product identity, required quantity, structure type, initial status, and core planning data. You can also set warehouse and location, order type, production line, schedule number, and links to projects or reference orders. Document and printing controls (for example how many picking lists or shop travelers to print) are defined at creation. Optional lot, shelf‑life and reclassification data, plus external references, support traceability and integration with external systems.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the new manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the item to be manufactured on the order.

inputParameters.name: STRT
inputParameters.description: Product structure type to use for the manufactured item on the new order.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: WHST
inputParameters.description: Initial status to assign to the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number where the new manufacturing order is created.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: Planned start date of the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: BDCD
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether lower-level manufacturing orders are generated for semi-finished components when the order is created.

inputParameters.name: RESP
inputParameters.description: User responsible for the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufactured product on the order will be produced or stored.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order type controlling processing rules and default values for the new order.

inputParameters.name: PROJ
inputParameters.description: Project number to link the manufacturing order to, if project-controlled.

inputParameters.name: WCLN
inputParameters.description: Production line on which the product for this manufacturing order will be produced.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to the manufacturing order, such as customer or purchase order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer or purchase order, linked to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line linked to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number to assign to the manufactured item on the order, if predefined.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: ELNO
inputParameters.description: Project element within the project structure associated with the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: NUC1
inputParameters.description: Number of put-away cards to print for the manufactured product on this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC2
inputParameters.description: Number of material requisitions normally printed for each material on this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC3
inputParameters.description: Number of labor tickets to print per operation on this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC4
inputParameters.description: Number of shop traveler documents to print for this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC5
inputParameters.description: Number of routing cards to print per operation on this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC6
inputParameters.description: Number of picking lists that should normally be printed for this order.

inputParameters.name: NUC7
inputParameters.description: Number of design documents to print for this product and order.

inputParameters.name: SCHN
inputParameters.description: Schedule number used to group the manufacturing order in production planning.

inputParameters.name: TX40
inputParameters.description: Short description text for the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MAUN
inputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the manufacturing order quantity is expressed.

inputParameters.name: DSP6
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP1
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether warnings about incomplete reporting are overridden when closing manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: DSP2
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP3
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP5
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP4
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP7
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: DSP8
inputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether specific scheduling warnings are overridden when closing the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: AOID
inputParameters.description: Alternate routing ID to use for the manufacturing order (field currently not used).

inputParameters.name: MEXP
inputParameters.description: Manual expiration date for the manufactured lot, overriding the calculated expiration date if set.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: Planned start time of the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the new manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MFPC
inputParameters.description: Process identifier referencing the process product structure to apply when creating the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse where the manufactured item will be stored or received.

inputParameters.name: PCCO
inputParameters.description: Process code classifying the manufacturing order, such as discrete, process, or pack order.

inputParameters.name: MREC
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be moved from quality status 1 to 2.

inputParameters.name: MRCT
inputParameters.description: Time of day on the manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be reclassified.

inputParameters.name: EXRN
inputParameters.description: External reference number storing a related ID from an external system for this manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: EXD2
inputParameters.description: Free-text description of the external reference linked to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: SAUT
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the PMS005 autojob for manufacturing order creation should be skipped when this order is created.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number created by this transaction.

outputParameters.name: BJNO
outputParameters.description: Batch job number of the PMS005 autojob triggered for this manufacturing order, if applicable.
